title: docs: map complex decoder bounds and restore PR968 replay route
body:
The onboarding link to the eight-term E8 bound does not explain the adjacent fixed-reader ninth-term exclusion or the narrower independent Gram certificate. In addition, PR968's documented direct verifier command exits at `G.selected-record` on current main because its pricing section expects #942.

This adds one bounded, source-linked scope map for retained PR845/968/1077/1098 and links it from autoresearch and the glossary. The map gives a reproducible historical replay using PR968's existing `--repo` option, pinned pricing inputs and the frozen #942 checkpoint in a temporary directory. The complete original verifier, selection guard, frame census, pricing and controls remain active. No predecessor package or selected record is edited, and no new theorem, decoder, supplier or kappa is claimed.

### Scope and provenance

- `scope-navigation`, priority revision 3; nonce `2f5e17a27f7174806a1785a7c24a478f`, scope key `b18e0e173a4430a9564b`. Refined to one four-result family index and its historical replay route. Exact reviewed heads and source links are in the map.
- Started from current main `ee055dc44815497927ef618fc985b93c2dcbda2a`; rebased onto refreshed main `0a201997097b8a89b638f3a2afcb35db4184c8b2`. All four consumed source packages, selected record and onboarding guidance remained byte-identical across that update.
- [Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1621). Final overlap refresh: 734 open PRs and 259 Discussion records, complete pagination, no coverage warnings, 2026-10-14 04:16 UTC. Coverage excludes arbitrary diffs/nested source. PR1232/1285 repair historical/current review routing; PR1133 studies fixed-reader support descent; neither supplies this map/replay route. Pending masked-decoder results are not represented as adopted results or declared open merely because this map excludes them.

### Validation

- All five documented package checks pass on CPython 3.14.7, including the complete PR968 historical replay, PR1077 extension, PR845 main/independent checkers and PR1098 Gram certificate. The documented historical replay and PR845 main check also pass on CPython 3.12.14. The direct current-selection PR968 run reproduces the expected guard failure; it is not a mathematical counterexample.
- All 20 repository `test_research_*.py` tests pass on Python 3.12.14. Local links and anchors (29), all four reviewed disposition heads, selected-record/source/proof integrity, clean worktree and diff whitespace checks pass.

The exact replay commands are in `docs/research/complex-decoder-scope-map.md`. The cited universal bounds retain their written arguments and geometric premises. No selected-supplier cold replay, physical admission, full multiplication formalization, hosted-CI success or independent human review is asserted.

Credit Mihir Srivastava/PR845, themilkman216/PR968, woklerx/PR1077, Adam Gall/PR1098, DreamingOfClouds/PR717/446/595, Joel Pulikkan/PR620 and the retained lineage. Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
